summary: The PR adds joblib to the dependencies listed in show_versions and includes a corresponding test. The change is minimal and aligns with the issue description.

issues.description: The addition of a new standalone script `test_show_versions.py` seems unrelated to the main issue of adding joblib to show_versions. It could be considered scope creep.
The new standalone script `test_show_versions.py` does not follow the typical testing conventions of the project, which usually involve placing tests within the `sklearn/utils/tests` directory.
